notes.title: ATC Infinite release for macOS!
notes.notes: You can now download ATC Infinite for macOS!

notes.title: Changelog v.1.1.1
notes.notes:
NEW: Added a radar "blip" to better show spawning aircraft. You can turn this on and off in the settings menu

UPDATE: Settings menu

notes.title: 1.1.0 Chained Commands Update
notes.notes:
It is now possible to do the following:
[code]LH312 TR 100 S 250 D 5000 [/code]
In any order you like:
[code]LH312 D 5000 S 250 TR 100 [/code]
Also:
[code]LH312 WAYPOINT S 200 D 5000 [/code]

Changelog:
[code]NEW: Chain up to three commands
FIX: A problem with loading the last saved state for the countdown
[/code]

Happy flying! 
Damian
